answer: Every claim climbs the willow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the kernel re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. By the beacon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
